text: Managing a team effectively requires more than just giving orders. Clear communication is the foundation, ensuring every member understands their role and the team’s goals. Equally important is delegation; trust your people with tasks that match their skills, rather than doing everything yourself. Regular feedback, both positive and constructive, helps everyone improve and feel valued. When disagreements arise, address them calmly and privately, focusing on the issue, not the person. Finally, keep motivation high by celebrating small wins and showing appreciation for hard work. A team that feels heard, respected, and supported will always perform better than one that is simply directed.
